title: A proof of the Athanasiadis-Chapoton ordinal-sum conjecture
summary: Given a finite preorder $τ$, we study how its order relation determines the $h^*$-polynomial of the associated polar preorder polytope. Let $\mathcal R_τ^{\vee}$ be the convex hull of the negative standard basis vectors and the indicator vectors of nonempty order ideals, and write $h_τ^*(t)=h^*(\mathcal R_τ^{\vee},t)$. Athanasiadis and Chapoton conjectured that this enumerative invariant takes ordinal sums to products: $$h_{τ_1\oplusτ_2}^*(t)=h_{τ_1}^*(t)\,h_{τ_2}^*(t).$$ We prove the conjecture for arbitrary finite preorders, including those with nontrivial equivalence classes.
